fact: The World Bank completion report says the eTransform project (Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation) installed a government cloud storage system of 1289TB, 703TB in Accra and 586TB in Kumasi, improving disaster recovery; places: Accra and Kumasi, which site is main and which is backup not stated, and the report does not call Kumasi a backup site.

Graphic Online reports the National Data Centre launched, run by NITA with Alcatel-Lucent and Huawei for all ministries, departments and agencies, with the primary centre in Accra and a secondary centre at the KNUST campus in Kumasi; main site in Accra, secondary in Kumasi.
